projectDescription: An opinionated full-stack Rust web framework that integrates Axum, Inertia.js, SeaORM, and a batteries-included CLI — one crate, one port, zero ceremony.
keyFeatures: Axum-powered HTTP routing with named routes, groups, and per-scope middleware
Native Inertia.js v3 server implementation — React, Vue, and Svelte, no npm package required
SeaORM + SQLx database layer supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite from one pool
Client Exposure Firewall: compile-time proof that only opt-in types reach the browser
Built-in auth: Argon2id password hashing, session management, CSRF, policies, OAuth 2 + PKCE
Database-backed job queue with fenced claims, retry policies, and a per-dialect claim strategy
In-process event dispatcher, mailer, notifications, and WebSocket/SSE realtime channels
OpenDAL-backed file storage (local filesystem and S3-compatible), with path traversal prevention
Structured JSON logging, Prometheus metrics, W3C Trace Context, and OTLP span export
RFC 9457 Problem Details for all error responses
TypeScript code generation from the application graph (typed routes, page props, form rules)
arc CLI: scaffold, dev loop with hot-reload on one port, migrations, typegen, and build
publicApiSurface: routes! { } macro — typed route declarations with named URL helpers
#[derive(arcature::Job)] / #[derive(arcature::Event)] — derive macros for queue and events
Auth<U>, OptionalAuth<U>, AuthManager<U>, Session, Flash, CsrfToken — auth extractors
text(), json(), redirect(), no_content() — response builders
Problem::of(kind) / Problem::custom(type_uri, status) — RFC 9457 error responses
arcature::database::{Db, QueryModel, Transaction, insert, update, delete, find_by_pk}
arc new / arc dev / arc serve / arc migrate / arc make:<kind> / arc typegen / arc build
